name: Visitor Visa

requirements.blocker_text: Visa requirement depends on nationality -- over 130 nationalities (including EU, Commonwealth, most Caribbean, USA, Japan, South Korea) are visa-exempt; other nationalities must apply prior to arrival or at the port of entry.

evidence_required.document: Visa (for non-exempt nationalities, applied prior to arrival or at port of entry)

outcome.duration_length: variable by nationality: commonly 14, 30, 60, 90 days or 6 months

sources.title: Embassy of Grenada -- Complete Country Visa Requirements for Grenada (April 2024): visa-exempt list of 130+ nationalities, visitor stay periods of 14/30/60/90 days or 6 months depending on nationality, non-exempt nationalities apply prior to arrival

notes: NEW ROUTE, part of Grenada's initial build. The nationality-visa-required requirement is modelled as hard: false since it is a routing/eligibility distinction rather than a genuine blocker for the many visa-exempt nationalities -- the underlying visa process for non-exempt nationals is a separate, not-yet-modelled sub-process. Passport validity period was not specified on this source (flagged as a gap). Also of note: 'Work Permits will NOT be processed for holders of Visitor Visas' per the Labour Department's Work Permit Guide -- visitors must change status before working, not simply add a work permit to an existing visitor visa (see gd_work_permit.json).
